source: made up: new dog owner working from home while juggling puppy walks, training, and a vet booster visit
persona: Maya, a UX researcher working remotely who adopted a 4-month-old rescue puppy (Biscuit) ten days ago. Texts affectionately but with mild sleep-deprived chaos, constantly planning her day around Biscuit's crate-nap windows and potty breaks.
situation: Wednesday morning at 06:30 when Biscuit starts whining in his crate. Has a 11:00 team sync, a 14:00 vet appointment for Biscuit's leptospirosis booster, UX interview synthesis notes to finish, and puppy training sessions.
life: 06:32 Wake up to Biscuit whining and text the app while clipping on his leash: up with the puppy! Help me plan today: morning puppy walk + feeding + 15-min clicker training now, my shower and breakfast once he goes in his crate at 07:45, work 09:00–17:30 (with a mid-morning potty break at 10:30, lunch walk at 12:15, and the 14:00–15:15 vet appointment), then an evening decompression sniff walk at 17:30.
06:35 Remind the app that I can only shower or do deep UX synthesis writing when Biscuit is asleep in his crate, and he can't hold his bladder longer than 3 hours.
06:35 Take Biscuit out for a 30-minute morning walk, feed him his kibble in a puzzle bowl, and practice 'sit' and 'leave it' clicker training until 07:45.
07:48 Report puppy walk, feeding, and clicker training done! Settling Biscuit in his crate with a frozen Kong so I can finally shower and make coffee/breakfast.
07:50 Shower, make coffee and avocado toast, and get dressed until 08:50.
08:52 Report shower and breakfast done. Logging in early to tag UX user interview transcripts while Biscuit is still sleeping.
08:55 Tag and synthesize UX interview videos in Dovetail until 10:25.

10:25 Biscuit wakes up barking; take him outside for a quick 15-minute potty break around the courtyard, then discovers he chewed the corner of the bathmat earlier—spend 10 minutes trimming loose threads and putting the rug up high.
10:52 Text the app: 10:30 potty break done (also had to rescue the bathmat from puppy teeth). Joining my 11:00 UX team sync now.
11:00 Attend UX Team Sync until 11:45, then finish summarizing the usability findings slide deck until 12:15.
12:18 Report usability deck draft done! Taking Biscuit out for his midday walk and grabbing a salad for lunch.
12:20 Walk Biscuit for 30 minutes, then eat a chopped salad at the counter while he chews a bully stick until 13:20.
13:22 Report midday walk and lunch done. Answering Slack threads for 20 minutes before loading Biscuit into the car at 13:40 for his 14:00 vet visit.
13:40 Drive Biscuit to Oakwood Vet Clinic; vet gives him his booster shot and trims his nails, getting back home at 15:15.

15:18 Text the app: back from the vet! Booster shot made Biscuit super sleepy so he went straight into his crate for a long nap. Going to lock in on finishing the Q4 research roadmap doc until 17:15, and also order a larger crate divider on Chewy.
15:20 Finish writing the Q4 research roadmap doc and order the crate divider on Chewy until 17:20.
17:22 Report research roadmap finished and Chewy order placed! Workday is done.
17:30 Take Biscuit to the quiet grassy park down the street for a slow 40-minute sniff walk until 18:10.
18:15 Feed Biscuit his dinner, then heat up lentil curry and naan for yourself until 19:15.
19:20 Report puppy walk and dinners done. Do 10 minutes of gentle crate-game training at 19:30, take Biscuit out for a final 22:00 potty trip, and crash at 22:30.
constraints: Puppy (Biscuit) needs a potty break or walk at least every 2.5 to 3 hours during the day.
Deep-focus UX synthesis work and showering can only happen when Biscuit is crated and napping.
Needs 20 minutes before and after the 14:00 vet appointment to load the puppy into the car seat harness and drive.
